# AstryxTable { #anylumino.AstryxTable }

```python
AstryxTable(
    rows=(),
    columns=None,
    *,
    row_key='id',
    selected=(),
    selects='',
    sortable=False,
    sort_key='',
    sort_direction='',
    select_all_label='Select all rows',
    width=None,
    height=None,
    **props,
)
```

Render a data-driven Astryx table for notebook use.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name             | Type                                           | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | Default             |
|------------------|------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------|
| rows             | Iterable\[Any\]                                | Rows or records rendered by the component.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | `()`                |
| columns          | Iterable\[Any\] \| Mapping\[str, Any\] \| None | Grid or table column definition.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | `None`              |
| row_key          | str \| None                                    | Row id field. Use ``None`` to generate notebook-local row ids.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | `'id'`              |
| selected         | Iterable\[Any\]                                | Initially selected row ids.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | `()`                |
| selects          | str                                            | Selection mode. Use ``""``, ``"single"``, or ``"multiple"``.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | `''`                |
| sortable         | bool                                           | Whether table columns should be sortable by default.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | `False`             |
| sort_key         | str                                            | Initially sorted table column key.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | `''`                |
| sort_direction   | str                                            | Initial sort direction, such as ``"asc"`` or ``"desc"``.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | `''`                |
| select_all_label | str                                            | Accessible label for the select-all checkbox.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | `'Select all rows'` |
| width            | int \| float \| str \| None                    | CSS width. Numbers are normalized by anylumino where supported.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | `None`              |
| height           | int \| float \| str \| None                    | CSS height. Numbers are normalized by anylumino where supported.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | `None`              |
| **props          | Any                                            | JSON-safe Table props. Useful keys: density, dividers, isStriped, hasHover, verticalAlign, textOverflow, className, and style. anylumino manages data, columns, idKey, selection plugins, sorting plugins, width, and height. See Astryx component docs: <https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/Table>. | `{}`                |

## Notes {.doc-section .doc-section-notes}

Row checkbox selection is optional. Leave ``selects`` empty for no checkbox column, use ``"single"`` or ``"multiple"`` to enable selection.

| [sort_key](#anylumino.AstryxTable.sort_key) | A trait for unicode strings. |

| --- | --- |
| [append_row](#anylumino.AstryxTable.append_row) | Append one raw row and return its normalized row id. |
| [on_select](#anylumino.AstryxTable.on_select) | Register or unregister a callback for table selection changes. |
| [on_sort](#anylumino.AstryxTable.on_sort) | Register or unregister a callback for table sort changes. |
| [prepend_row](#anylumino.AstryxTable.prepend_row) | Prepend one raw row and return its normalized row id. |
| [remove_row](#anylumino.AstryxTable.remove_row) | Remove an existing row by row id. |
| [set_rows](#anylumino.AstryxTable.set_rows) | Replace table rows from raw row mappings, sequences, or scalar values. |
| [update_row](#anylumino.AstryxTable.update_row) | Update cells for an existing row by row id. |

### append_row { #anylumino.AstryxTable.append_row }

```python
AstryxTable.append_row(row, *, row_key=None)
```

Append one raw row and return its normalized row id.

### on_select { #anylumino.AstryxTable.on_select }

```python
AstryxTable.on_select(callback, remove=False)
```

Register or unregister a callback for table selection changes.

### on_sort { #anylumino.AstryxTable.on_sort }

```python
AstryxTable.on_sort(callback, remove=False)
```

Register or unregister a callback for table sort changes.

### prepend_row { #anylumino.AstryxTable.prepend_row }

```python
AstryxTable.prepend_row(row, *, row_key=None)
```

Prepend one raw row and return its normalized row id.

### remove_row { #anylumino.AstryxTable.remove_row }

```python

```

### set_rows { #anylumino.AstryxTable.set_rows }

```python

```

Replace table rows from raw row mappings, sequences, or scalar values.

### update_row { #anylumino.AstryxTable.update_row }

```python
AstryxTable.update_row(row_value, values)
```
